title: 6 BORING Machines That Pay You Every Month (Ice, Water, Office Coffee)
promo_conflict: No sponsor or affiliate is disclosed; named operators and pricing sources are presented as examples, so any relationship is not assessable from the transcript.

idea.name: Bottleless office water cooler rental and service
idea.one_liner: Rent plumbed water coolers to offices and handle installation, filters, cleaning and repairs for a recurring fee.
idea.customer: Offices switching from jug delivery, including office managers and building managers.
idea.offer: Bottleless coolers with installation, filter changes, cleaning and repairs.
idea.revenue_model: Monthly equipment rental and service agreements, with pricing that can vary by headcount.

The fee covers the filters, the cleaning, and the fixes.

Then he placed his first four coolers in two offices on his own street.
